caption: The drawing depicts a single large bronze bell positioned upright against a plain, light-colored background. The bell is colored in shades of brown and green, indicative of aged or weathered metal, and has a rough, textured surface. Near the top, there are two broken metal loops protruding upward, which likely served as mounting points. Around the upper part of the bell, there is an engraved horizontal band that bears an inscription with partially legible letters. The bell widens toward the bottom, ending in a broad, flared lip with visible wear and irregularities. There are prominent cracks and signs of damage on the bell’s surface. The composition is centered, with the bell occupying the majority of the frame, and there is a small artist’s signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Church Bell
